verses.text: <pb/>Chineke, mb͕e Ọ gwarari nna-ayi-hà okwu n'oge ochie nime ndi-amuma n'iberibe-akwukwọ di iche iche na uzọ di iche iche,
Ọ gwara ayi okwu n'ọgwugwu ubọchi ndia nime Ọkpara, Onye O doro onye-nketa nke ihe nile, Onye O site-kwa-ra n'aka-Ya me uwa nile;
Onye, ebe Ọ bu nnwupu nke ebube-Ya na onyinyo nke udi-Ya, ebe O nēbu kwa ihe nile site n'okwu nke ike-Ya, mb͕e Ọ sachasiri nmehie nile ayi, O we nọdu n'aka-nri nke Idi-uku ahu di n'elu;
ebe emere Ya-ri ka Ọ ka ndi-mọ-ozi nma n'uzọ ra otú O ketawa aha nke ka nma.

N'ihi na ọ̀ bu onye n'etiti ndi-mọ-ozi ka Ọ siri mb͕e ọ bula, <pb/><t>Ọkparam ka Gi onwe-gi bu,</t> <t>Mu onwem amuwo Gi ta?</t> <pb/>ọzọ kwa, <pb/><t>Mu onwem gāburu Ya Nna,</t> <t>Ya onwe-ya gābu-kwa-ram Ọkpara?</t>
<pb/>Ma ọzọ kwa, mb͕e ọ bula Ọ gākpọbatawori Ọkpara ahu n'elu-uwa ebe madu bi, Ọ si, Ka ndi-mọ-ozi nile nke Chineke kpọ kwa isi ala nye Ya.
Ọ nēkwu kwa ihe bayere ndi-mọ-ozi, si, <pb/><t>Onye nēme ndi-mọ-ozi-Ya ka ha buru ifufe,</t> <t>Nēme kwa ndi nējere Ya ozi ka ha buru ọku nēnwu enwu:</t>
<pb/>ma Ọ nēkwu ihe bayere Ọkpara ahu, si, <pb/><t>Oche-eze-gi, Chineke, nādiru mb͕e nile ebighi-ebi;</t> <t>Nkpa-n'aka-eze nke izi-ezi ka nkpa-n'aka nke ala-eze-Gi bu kwa.</t>
<t>I huru ezi omume n'anya, we kpọ nmebi-iwu asì;</t> <t>N'ihi nka Chineke, bú Chineke-Gi, tere Gi</t> <t>Manu obi-utọ n'isi kari ndi-nketa-ibe-Gi.</t>
<pb/>Ọzọ kwa, <pb/><t>Gi onwe-gi, Onye-nwe-ayi, na mbu ka I tọrọ ntọ-ala nke uwa;</t> <t>Ọlu aka-Gi ka elu-igwe bu kwa:</t>
<t>Ha onwe-ha gāla n'iyì; ma Gi onwe-gi nānọgide:</t> <t>Ha nile gāka kwa nká dika uwe;</t>
<t>Dika ákwà-nb͕okwasi ka I gāpiakọta kwa ha,</t> <t>Dika uwe, agāb͕anwe kwa ha:</t> <t>Ma Gi onwe-gi bu Onye ahu Nke nādi mb͕e nile,</t> <t>Arọ-Gi nile agaghi-agwu kwa agwu.</t>
<pb/>Ma ọ̀ bu onye n'etiti ndi-mọ-ozi ka O kwuworo okwu bayere ya mb͕e ọ bula, si, <pb/><t>Nọdu ala n'aka-nrim,</t> <t>Rue mb͕e M'gēdo ndi-iro-Gi ka ihe-nb͕akwasi ukwu-Gi abua?</t>
<pb/>Hà nile abughi ndi-mọ nēfè òfùfè, ndi eziputara ije ozi n'ihi ndi gaje iketa nzọputa?
